taxonomy.note: Stable species-level canonical entry; accepted local infraspecific concept S. ericoides var. ericoides is taught internally.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays Natural Purola flora records S. ericoides; Travis herbarium and Williamson county treatment document accepted var. ericoides. Current Kew accepts S. ericoides var. ericoides.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; infraspecific records counted only after current-taxonomy reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the tiny stiff leaves. White heath aster is a low rhizomatous perennial with many small narrow pointed leaves, short-strigose stems, and masses of small white-rayed heads.
diagnostic_traits: many small narrow stiff pointed leaves
